MiniMaxH3LatentContinuationGuide.description: Guide the next segment directly with the tail of the previous audio/video latent, without VAE decoding or re-encoding. Keep the existing sampler; remove trim_frames and the corresponding audio from the beginning of the new segment when joining.

positive.name: positive
positive.tooltip: Positive conditioning for the next segment. Connect the output to BasicGuider, CFGGuider, or KSampler.

latent.name: Current latent
latent.tooltip: Empty H3 audio/video latent for the next segment. Also connect it directly to the next sampler.

previous_latent.name: Previous latent
previous_latent.tooltip: Complete audio/video latent from the previous sampler, not an empty latent. Both segments must have the same resolution.

context_frames.name: Context frames
context_frames.tooltip: Read the last 5, 22, 39, 56, ... frames from the previous segment. Default: 22. Shortened automatically when needed. The new segment length includes this overlap.

1.name: trim_frames
1.tooltip: Frames to remove from the beginning of the new segment when joining. Also remove trim_frames / 24 seconds from its audio.

H3LoopPromptSchedule.description: Combine shared descriptions with segment actions. Separate segments with --- on its own line. The first segment starts the video; the remaining segments drive the continuation loop.

segments.name: Segment actions (separate with ---)
segments.tooltip: The first block is the opening segment; each following block is one continuation. N continuations require at least N + 1 blocks.

H3VideoPromptPlan.description: Combine shared descriptions with segment actions. Separate segments with --- on its own line. Choose the starting segment or repeat the final prompt when needed.

repeat_last.name: Repeat the final prompt
repeat_last.tooltip: Enable to use one prompt for every segment, or repeat the final prompt when there are fewer prompts than segments.

start_segment.name: Starting prompt segment
start_segment.tooltip: Segment numbering starts at 1. Use 1 for the complete video. To retry segment 3, choose 3 and set the generator to one segment. Multiple segments use subsequent prompts in order.

H3LongVideo.display_name: H3 Long Video: Generate + Merge by SGUN
H3LongVideo.description: Save each segment to output as soon as it finishes, with optional complete audio/video LATENT files. The merged video is assembled and saved only by a connected external Save Video node. Without it, generation and segment saving still work.

segments.name: Segments to generate
segments.tooltip: Number of new segments to generate in this run. A connected previous LATENT supplies continuation context; it is excluded from this count and from the exported video.

duration.name: Segment duration
duration.tooltip: Uses the official 24 fps and 17k + 5 frame grid. The actual duration may differ slightly.

steps.name: Sampling steps
steps.tooltip: Used when custom sigmas are not connected. With custom sigmas, the sequence determines the actual number of sampling steps.

scheduler.name: Scheduler
scheduler.tooltip: Skipped when custom sigmas are connected.

context_frames.name: Context frames
context_frames.tooltip: Read the tail of the previous audio/video latent directly. Remove the overlap automatically when exporting continuation segments.

seed_mode.name: Segment seeds
seed_mode.tooltip: The first segment uses the seed above. Later segments use fixed, increment, decrement, or randomize. Randomize chooses new later seeds each time a multi-segment run is queued, even if the first seed is fixed. Generation info records the actual seeds.

denoise.name: Denoise
denoise.tooltip: Used only by the internal scheduler. Connected custom sigmas are used directly.

save_latents.name: Save each LATENT
save_latents.tooltip: Save a complete audio/video .h3latent and manifest in the batch _data directory after each segment. Use H3 Load Audio/Video LATENT to resume. Uses more disk space without retaining all segment latents in memory.

filename_prefix.name: Save prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Normal generation saves final MP4 files in a numbered directory such as output/H3_00001, with auxiliary files in _data. Retrying a segment in output uses its original batch and ignores this prefix; filenames retain the logical segment number and increment the retry count. The external Save Video node controls the merged filename.

dynamic_mask.name: Dynamic mask
dynamic_mask.tooltip: Applies only to continuations. Dynamically denoise the context according to sigma while protecting the seam and audio prefix. Intended for drift comparisons; lost details may not recover. Requires native H3 audio/video mask support and cannot be combined with another dynamic mask.

sigmas.name: sigmas
sigmas.tooltip: Connect Manual Sigmas or another SIGMAS source to use the exact sequence for every segment, overriding the internal scheduler, steps, and denoise.

previous_latent.name: Previous LATENT
previous_latent.tooltip: Connect H3 Load Audio/Video LATENT or the last LATENT from another generator. Requires complete audio/video data at the same resolution. Set segments to 1 to regenerate the next segment separately.

drift_correction.name: Color and brightness drift correction
drift_correction.tooltip: Lightly correct color and contrast statistics in continuation video latents. Preserve the first segment, audio, leading overlap, and trailing continuation context without extra sampling. Recommended for continuous shots; disable for intentional lighting or scene changes.

retry_segment.name: Retry segment record (optional)
retry_segment.tooltip: Filled automatically by the segment panel below. Restore the continuation context and retry into the original output batch, for example segment_0002_retry_001.mp4. Retrying a retry retains its logical segment number and increments the retry count without overwriting. Clear to return to normal generation.

retry_prompt.name: Retry prompt (blank uses record)
retry_prompt.tooltip: Edit after selecting a segment and restoring its settings. Used only in retry mode; leaves the shared prompt node unchanged.

retry_seed.name: Custom retry seed
retry_seed.tooltip: Used only when retry seed mode is custom. Enter the complete integer from 0 to 18446744073709551615. Restoring a segment preserves its exact recorded seed without browser rounding.

live_preview.name: Preview sampling (adds time)
live_preview.tooltip: Decode sampling frames in sequence with the local taeh3_temporal.safetensors and play them over the settings panel. When off, no preview model is loaded and no sampling thumbnails are generated.

preview_interval.name: Preview interval (steps)
preview_interval.tooltip: Update after this many sampling steps. The first and final steps still update. Larger values reduce decoding work.

preview_frames.name: Preview frames (automatic)
preview_frames.tooltip: Hidden legacy input. Preview frame count follows the segment's actual exported frame count, excluding continuation overlap. Saved values are ignored.

preview_max_resolution.name: Preview longest edge
preview_max_resolution.tooltip: Limit only the sampling preview decoding size. The final video resolution stays the same.

preview_fps.name: Preview frame rate
preview_fps.tooltip: Default 10. 24 fps matches the final video speed; lower values play slower and higher values play faster. Changes only preview playback; exported video stays at 24 fps.

retry_seed_mode.name: Retry seed mode
retry_seed_mode.tooltip: Used only for retries. randomize picks a new seed on every run; original uses the actual seed in the segment record; custom uses the custom retry seed.

0.name: Merged video
0.tooltip: Merge and save the complete video only when connected to an external Save Video node. No switch is needed.

3.name: LATENT file paths
3.tooltip: Paths to .h3latent files in segment order when Save each LATENT is enabled; otherwise an empty list.

H3LoadLatent.display_name: H3 Load Audio/Video LATENT by SGUN
H3LoadLatent.description: Load .h3latent files saved by this extension, preserving the original audio/video tensor values and dtype. Paths must be inside the ComfyUI input, output, or temp directories.

latent_path.name: Manual path (optional)
latent_path.tooltip: Usually leave blank and use the file list below. A supplied or connected path takes priority, preserving existing workflows.

latent_file.name: Saved LATENT
latent_file.tooltip: Scan output, input, temp, and their subdirectories. Newest files appear first. Refresh the list after saving a new segment.

H3DigitalHuman.display_name: H3 Digital Human: Audio-Driven Long Video by SGUN
H3DigitalHuman.description: Generate video from the source audio duration and segment prompts. Connected outputs determine whether to produce a complete video or individual segments. Merge the complete video only for external saving; keep internal files temporary.

audio.name: Source audio
audio.tooltip: Speech or a song. The original audio is assembled continuously once; the model generates only the visuals.

prompt.name: Single prompt (legacy)
prompt.tooltip: Describe the character, scene, and ongoing performance for the entire video. Do not add an <Audio 1> tag unless that reference is connected.

segment_seconds.name: Segment duration
segment_seconds.tooltip: Includes continuation context. Choose the nearest 5.875, 8, 10.125, 12.25, or 14.375 seconds automatically. Shorter segments can reduce peak VRAM use.

sigmas.name: sigmas
sigmas.tooltip: Optional. Use an existing SIGMAS sequence directly, overriding internal sampling steps and the scheduler.

tiled_decode.name: Tiled decoding
tiled_decode.tooltip: Use official tiled VAE decoding by default to reduce peak VRAM use.

prompts.name: Segment prompts
prompts.tooltip: Connect H3 Long Video Prompts to override the legacy single prompt and use one prompt per actual segment. Report missing prompts before generation.

0.name: Complete video
0.tooltip: Merge and save the complete video with the original audio only when connected to an external Save Video node. No switch is needed.

2.name: Segment videos
2.tooltip: VIDEO list in segment order, each with the matching source audio. Connect another Save Video node to save segments for editing.
